# Hisdayspring Ministries International

> Raising holy, healthy and wealthy people with a sense of dominion and world evangelism by the power of the Holy Spirit. A Pentecostal church in Lagos, Nigeria with branches in Ipaja, Ikeja and Ikorodu.

Services: Sundays 8:00 AM & 10:30 AM. Phone: +234-906-619-2155. Email: hello@hisdayspring.org.

## Pages

- [Home](https://hisdayspring.org/): service times, ministries, events, gallery and contact.
- [Meet Our Pastors](https://hisdayspring.org/pastors): lead pastors, branch pastors and ministers.
- [Giving](https://hisdayspring.org/giving): tithes, offerings and seeds online by card or bank transfer, plus pastor & ministerial giving sent directly to the pastor's own bank account.
- [Ministries](https://hisdayspring.org/ministries/yofic): youth ministry (YOFIC), and other church ministries.
- [Events](https://hisdayspring.org/#events): conferences, crusades and special services.
- [Live Stream](https://hisdayspring.org/live): watch Sunday services live on YouTube.
- [Radio](https://hisdayspring.org/radio): Hisdayspring radio stream.
- [Books](https://hisdayspring.org/books): publications by Pastor Blessing Olamijulo.
- [Welfare](https://hisdayspring.org/welfare): community welfare and outreach programmes.
- [Crusade](https://hisdayspring.org/crusade): Healing From Heaven crusade information.
- [Testimonies](https://hisdayspring.org/testimonials): testimonies of transformed lives.
- [Prayer Requests](https://hisdayspring.org/prayer): submit a prayer request via WhatsApp.
- [Privacy Policy](https://hisdayspring.org/privacy): how we handle personal data.
